errors.name: UserNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a user is not found by their ID during authentication or lookup.

errors.name: DocumentNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a document is not found by its ID during retrieval or deletion.

errors.name: UnauthorizedAccessError
errors.description: Raised when a user attempts to access a document that does not belong to them.

errors.name: DocumentOwnershipError
errors.description: Raised when a user tries to modify or delete a document not owned by them.
